title: Technical Engineer (Concord, NC)
description:
Paladin Consulting is currently hiring a ­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­Technical Engineer to join our team working onsite at our client's office located in Concord, NC.

We work with companies that offer environments for our employees to contribute, learn, and advance their career. We treat you like you are part of the family.

Job Title: Technical Engineer
Work Location: Concord, NC
Duration: Long-term contract with option to hire
Hours: Monday-Friday 7am-3:30pm
Education/Experience Required: Engineering degree

Job Description:
As a Technical Engineer, you will be responsible for engineering operations and the direction of technicians, vendors, and subcontractors.
This job is part of the Engineering and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for providing support, preventive maintenance, and repairs on equipment and systems.

Responsibilities :
  • Comply with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency, and Company directives related to building operations and work safety.
  • Oversee operations, assign work orders, and provide technical and procedural training of coworkers and subcontractors.
  • Consult with clients to schedule preventive maintenance and other downtime to minimize business interruption and inconvenience.
  • Formulate and implement a preventive maintenance program to ensure that building machinery and systems meet or exceed their rated life.
  • Oversee and inspect the work performed by engineering staff.
  • Confirm that work is complete, equipment is fully functional and client space is in prime working condition.
  • Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning additional assistance as needed.
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish complex assignments and provide innovative solutions.
  • Coach others and share in-depth knowledge of own job discipline and broad knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with client RISE values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.
  • Impact a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams.
  • Work within broad guidelines and policies.
  • Explain difficult or sensitive information.
Resource's typical working day:
  • Perform RCA, provide technical guidance to technicians, develop PM programs, create and develop Job Plans, validate commissioning information for new equipment, perform asset lifecycle evaluation.
Skills & Qualifications :
  • High School Diploma, GED, or trade school diploma with 4-5 years of job-related experience. In lieu of a diploma, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Certifications/licenses as may be required by local or state jurisdictions. Prior shift manager or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
  • Ability to exercise judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.
  • Willingness to take a new perspective on existing solutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.
Licenses/Certifications:
  • OSHA 10 Construction (Preferred but not necessary)
Must Have Skills:
  • Facility experience with HVAC, water systems, air systems
Nice to have skills:
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
Soft Skills:
  • Customer service skills, ability to communicate technical issues to non-technical persons.
Software skills:
  • Ability to use CMMS system, Email

For more information or to view other opportunities, visit us at www.paladininc.com.

Paladin is an EEOC employer.

title: D365 Manager, Enterprise Applications
description:
Paladin Consulting is currently hiring a D365 Enterprise Applications Manager to join our team working onsite at our client's office located in The Woodlands, TX.

We work with companies that offer environments for our employees to contribute, learn, and advance their career. We treat you like you are part of the family.

Job Title: D365 Enterprise Applications Manager
Work Location: The Woodlands, TX (preferred); Alternate locations available: Cypress, TX; Las Vegas, NV; Columbia, MD; or Honolulu, HI;
Duration: Full Time Direct Hire with Salary & Bonus Eligibility

About The Opportunity:
The Manager, Enterprise Applications – Microsoft D365 is responsible for the functional and technical leadership, support, governance, and continuous improvement of clients Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) platform and related enterprise applications. This role oversees enterprise ERP operations across Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, and integrated business systems while also supporting interim JD Edwards and Coupa environments during the company's ERP transformation initiatives.

The position partners closely with Accounting, Finance, Procurement, Operations, Development, and IT leadership to deliver scalable ERP solutions, optimize business processes, improve operational performance, and support enterprise modernization efforts. This role also provides leadership for ERP support operations, release management, system governance, integrations, data integrity, and post-go-live stabilization activities.

This role serves as a strategic and operational leader responsible for driving ERP adoption, process standardization, platform optimization, and long-term application sustainability while ensuring enterprise systems remain stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

Job Description & Responsibilities:
  • Lead the administration, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) and related enterprise applications.
  • Provide interim support and operational oversight for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, Coupa, and integrated legacy ERP platforms during transformation initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex cross-functional ERP and enterprise application issues.
  • Lead prioritization of support activities, enhancements, system improvements, and operational initiatives aligned with business priorities.
  • Support ERP implementation, integration, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization activities across Finance, Procurement, Operations, and Supply Chain functions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable ERP and enterprise application solutions.
  • Oversee advanced incident management, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and monitor SLAs, support metrics, operational reporting, and service delivery performance standards.
  • Lead release management, change control, testing coordination, deployment planning, and production cutover activities.
  • Ensure compliance with IT governance standards, SOX controls, audit requirements, change management procedures, and operational best practices.
  • Oversee ERP configurations, workflows, business units, financial structures, integrations, and operational data management processes.
  • Ensure data integrity, reconciliation accuracy, and reliable integration performance across financial and operational systems.
  • Coordinate with vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and internal teams to support enterprise application initiatives and issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, integration, and data teams to support integrated technology operations.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, standardization, and operational efficiency initiatives across enterprise platforms.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and development support to analysts, specialists, and support personnel within the Enterprise Applications team.
  • Promote cross-functional knowledge sharing and operational resiliency to reduce single-person dependency risks.
  • Support user training, knowledge management, adoption activities, and executive stakeholder communications related to enterprise platforms and ERP initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Business, or a related field required; equivalent experience considered.
  • Significant experience supporting enterprise applications and ERP platforms within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) and/or Supply Chain Management.
  • Experience supporting JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, Coupa, or related ERP and procurement platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Operations, and Supply Chain business processes.
  • Experience supporting ERP implementations, migrations, post-go-live stabilization, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application support, configurations, workflows, integrations, operational governance, and release management processes.
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional issues, operational priorities, and enterprise support activities.
  • Working knowledge of reporting tools, structured data, SQL-style queries, exports, reconciliations, and operational reporting processes.
  • Strong understanding of IT governance frameworks including ITIL, SOX compliance, change management, and audit controls.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Power Platform technologies.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong organizational, communication, documentation, and leadership skills with the ability to support both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience building internal capabilities, reducing reliance on external vendors, and improving operational support maturity.
  • Demonstrated "can-do” attitude, collaboration, adaptability, and customer-focused service mindset.
  • Demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, with a track record of learning and applying innovative digital tools to improve operational efficiency, reporting, automation, and business outcomes.

For more information or to view other opportunities, visit us at www.paladininc.com.

Paladin Consulting is an EEOC employer.
